review_notes.location: Literal function glyphs AF, AG, AP
review_notes.evidence: Native enlarged function crops retain the printed H forms; AE is clear A. Card type or neighboring gates are not used to override those source glyphs.

Native crop CS041 bare NOR.png shows OR, DOT and 6D-AT only with printed partial top and vertical strokes. No card, unit, or physical location is invented. Explicitly modeled virtual element has two input triangles and one output triangle.

The scan explicitly prints AW4. The A1 connector reference at identical board and pin is CS041AJ4; this source inconsistency is noted, not silently overwritten. Other three footer board/connector/pin references corroborate AW4 in A1.

245 columns by 103 rows; ordinary blocks width8, top rows2+7n and columns50+23n fitted independently from native borders. Source port offsets and borders retained; external rows and source-only hanging references re-read. Human-confirmed AP template c0/c31 is used for left strings/origins. Earlier c2/c33 pixel estimate remains unresolved bearing/crop/stretch calibration, not a source exception.

review_notes.location: Native unjoined crossings at first wire cells
review_notes.evidence: CS041 left native rails.png shows AX output rail c61 crossing AY output B08/D06 first wire cells without diamonds; TGR0_PLUS rail c69 crosses AB.D10/AB.B09/AC.D07/AC.B12 first wire cells without diamonds. Horizontal pin attachment retains its declared owner; crossing vertical net remains unjoined. Six explicit source-evidenced endpoint-crossing exceptions validate directions, not mere cell coincidence.
